verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox documents explicit region selection, per sandbox or as a project default, across iad1, sfo1, cle1 and cdg1 (an EU option is included), which delivers the core of choosing where sandboxes and their data live. missing for 10: explicit data-residency guarantees for persisted state (auto-snapshots, Drives, images in VCR), a broader documented region list beyond four, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Vercel Sandbox is available in the `iad1` (default), `sfo1`, `cle1`, and `cdg1` regions. You can choose the region per sandbox or set a project default.
Vercel Sandbox is now available in all regions
